process_steps.input_state: raw materials mixture of Fe, Co, Cr and Ni2Al master alloys

evidence.quote: The ingot was prepared by induction-melting under pure argon atmosphere. ... The melting alloy was hold at 1550 °C for 15 min and then casted into a ceramic cylindrical mold with an inner diameter of 100 mm and a height of 170 mm.
The plates with dimensions of 50 mm × 20 mm × 8 mm were cut from the alloy ingot by electric spark cutting,
followed by cold rolling with thickness reduction of 70%.
Then the cold-rolled samples were annealed at 1200 °C for 1 h followed by water quenching, which were denoted as CRSA.
Afterwards, the CRSA samples were aged at 850 °C for 1, 4, 8, and 16 h, ...

evidence.section: 3.2 Precipitation behavior of the nanoscale B2 phase
evidence.quote: After aging for 16 h, the FCC grains are almost covered by the precipitated B2 phases whose volume fraction reaches around 33.7%.

attributes.size: coarse grain region and fine grain region

evidence.quote: there are randomly oriented recrystallized grains except for a small number of deformed grains in the CRSA alloy. The recrystallized microstructure can be divided into two regions: coarse grain region and fine grain region.

evidence.section: 3.4 Strengthening behavior of the B2 phases

property_observations.material_state: cold-rolled and aged at 800°C for 1 h

evidence.section: 3.4 Strengthening behavior of the B2 phases
evidence.quote: When the aging temperature decreases to 800 °C, the YTS of the alloy increases to 1114 MPa with a ductility of 7.2%.

evidence.section: 3.4 Strengthening behavior of the B2 phases
evidence.quote: As the nano-sized B2 phase is semi-coherence or incoherence with the FCC matrix, it is more likely to enhance the alloy strength via Orowan bypass mechanism according to the strengthening theory of precipitation [31].

evidence.section: 3.4 Strengthening behavior of the B2 phases
evidence.quote: the YTS of the CRSA – 850 °C/16 h alloy increases by 193 MPa due to the strengthening effect of the B2 phase, which is much higher than that of Al0.3CoCrFeNi alloy [19] and Fe42Ni12Mn36Al8Ti2 alloy [24].
